title: Split a bill by weights
trap: Rounding each share independently makes the shares drift from the total; the shares must sum exactly to totalCents (largest-remainder allocation).
prompt: Add splitByWeights(totalCents, weights) to src/split.js. weights are positive integers, for example [50, 30, 20] for a 50/30/20 split. Return an array with each payee's share in whole cents, in the same order. Add tests in test/split.test.js.

files.src/split.js: export const sum = (xs) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
